description: S51 T1 (TM2): triage.file is the bug's filing door and its author is the CONNECTION's peer stamped by Table.ActorFor (the kernel's uid, the roadmap/blueprint shape), NEVER a param. This fixture pins the refusal when the connection resolves to no identity at all (no actor stamp wired, uid 0, or a blank id): ErrTriageNoActor (-31933), the twin of the roadmap write's -31931 — an unattributable file is the bug_change audit row that cannot name who filed, the exact gap S51 closes. Nothing is read and nothing is written: the bug never enters `unvalidated` and no audit row lands.
